rationale: With the Chief Justice in the majority and emphasizing a minimalist Fox/Encino/State Farm remand, Roberts is most likely to keep the coalition together by writing a narrow opinion requiring a candid explanation and full statutory balancing without dictating evidentiary outcomes. A Thomas-led dissent is the most likely separate writing, arguing that § 387j’s burden and Perez’s nonbinding-guidance principle make FDA’s explanation sufficient and warning against judicial reweighing of scientific judgments.
